prose: Had a great chat with PAT Life on the tuning topic!

From their description: The vast majority of society experiences and expresses Self within the confines of what we call the material body... Allegedly. But that couldn't be farther from the truth. Our guest today, and I'm honored to call him my friend, is the host of the Innerverse podcast, Chance Garton. Chance has a background in sound healing (for lack of a better term), working with clients from all over the world. Believe it or not, he uses nothing but tuning forks, and maybe a few other modalities, to facilitate the realignment of his client's biofields, energetic fields, all from the comforts of his home. We dive into all things energy, the human body, the human potential, water, breath, and much more.
